# Best power banks for a MacBook Pro

**Best overall: Anker Prime Power Bank (26,250mAh, 300W)**, about $200-230
- It has two USB-C ports at 140W (PD 3.1) and a 300W total output. It can fast-charge a 16-inch MacBook Pro, or two laptops at once.
- At 99.75Wh it stays under the 100Wh airline limit.
- Macworld's test fully charged a 14-inch M2 MacBook Pro and then recharged it to 25% more. It has no built-in cable, but a 240W USB-C cable is included, according to Macworld.
- [Macworld's roundup with price links](https://www.macworld.com/article/2395511/best-laptop-power-banks-for-apple-macbook.html) | [WIRED's review](https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/)

**Best with a built-in cable: EcoFlow RAPID Pro 27K (300W)**, about $220 list, with Amazon sales as low as roughly $110-190 in the reviews
- It has a retractable 140W USB-C cable plus 3 more USB-C ports, so it can run two 16-inch MacBook Pros at full speed.
- At 99.54Wh it's also airline-legal. Macworld estimates it recharges a laptop about 70-75% in practice.
- [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/2955100/ecoflow-rapid-pro-27k-power-bank-300w-review-macbook-battery-pack.html) | [WIRED's review](https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/)

**Best value: ReelCharge ReelPro (27,000mAh, 200W)**, about $120
- It has a built-in cable that delivers up to 140W, plus a 3-year warranty. WIRED notes ReelCharge is a new brand, so it's a bit riskier, and it only has two ports.
- [WIRED's review](https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/)

**Budget pick: Baseus Blade H1 (20,000mAh, 100W)**, $89.99
- At 100W it's fine for a 14-inch MacBook Pro or Air, but it won't reach the 16-inch's 140W fast-charge speed. At about 74Wh it's carry-on legal, and Baseus doesn't publish how power is split when you charge several devices at once.
- Treat this one with a bit more caution: the source is an affiliate site that says it's the only bank in its records, so it isn't a comparison against the others.
- [Buy the Baseus Blade H1](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-blade-h1-100w-20000mah) (affiliate link)

## Tips
- **16-inch Pro:** pick a 140W PD 3.1 bank. Macworld says you'll also need Apple's USB-C to MagSafe 3 cable, or a Thunderbolt 5 cable on M4/M5 models, for full 140W speed. Ordinary USB-C tops out at 100W on older models.
- **14-inch Pro or Air:** 100W is enough.
- **Flying:** keep the bank under 100Wh. That's why the 26-27K mAh models are the practical ceiling.
- **Capacity:** no bank gives a full 100% recharge of a 16-inch Pro because of conversion losses, so expect roughly 70-80%.

My pick: the Anker Prime 26K if you want the best performer, or the ReelPro if you want to spend less.
